experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: Typical Procedure for Preparation of Benzyl Phenyl Ether (Entry 1). experimental_procedure: General/Typical Procedure: General Procedure A phenol or naphthol (2 mmol) and anhydrous base (1 g) were ground altogether into fine powder and heated at 60°C under vigorous stirring. Alkylating agent (2 mmol) was added and heated under vigorous stirring, and the progress of reaction was monitored by thin-layer chromatography (TLC) (by dissolving the sample in ethyl acetate) until the conversion of phenol was completed. Then, water was added to the mixture, and the solid ether was filtrated and washed with additional water. In the case of liquid ethers, the products were extracted with diethyl ether. The solvent (diethyl ether) was evaporated, and the crude product was purified by short-column chromatography using petroleum ether-ethylacetate as eluent or by recrystallization in ethylacetate-n-hexan (in the case of solid ethers). 4-Benzyloxy benzaldehyde, yield 82%. General/Typical Procedure: General method for the synthesis of 2-aryloxy-N,N-diethyletanamine hydrochlorides. A mixture of 0.1 mole of the corresponding phenol. 70 ml toluene, 0.1 mole of hydrochloride or hydrobromide (2-chloro- or 2-bromo-, respectively) of N,N-diethylethanamine, and 12.5 g of comminuted NaOH was boiled with stirring for 8 h on a sand bath, cooled, alkalized with a NaOH solution until obtaining an alkaline reaction, and extracted with ether (150 ml). The ether - toluene extract was washed with NaOH solution until complete discoloration of the aqueous phase. The organic layer was dried over crystalline NaOH and filtered. The filtrate was purged with dry HCl and the precipitated 2-aryloxy-N,N-diethyletanamine hydrochloride was separated by filtration, washed with ether, and crystallized from an appropriate solvent. In cases where no solvent for crystallization can be found, the product is purified by converting it onto the base form and repeated purging with dry HCl. Compound XXX, yield 73.1%.
